app.name: Hockey Club

login.title: Sign in

join.title: Join the club
join.intro: You are using a club invite. Create your account to come in.

join.sentStep2: You join the club by yourself, with no second sign in.
join.resendWait: You can ask for it again in {n} seconds

members.title: Members
member.groupsHint: Tap a group to add or remove the person.
member.rolesHint: With no role the person is a player. Only the board gives out roles.
member.removeConfirm: You are about to remove {name} from the club. They lose access and their profile is deleted. This cannot be undone.
profile.title: My profile
profile.noGroups: You are not in any group yet.
invites.title: Invites
invites.intro: Links that let new members join the club. Whoever opens the link creates an account and is added to the chosen group.

events.title: Events
unanswered.title: Who has not answered
unanswered.intro: People who have not yet answered for the events of the coming days, with the contacts to reach them.
summary.title: Attendance
summary.intro: Finished events, per player. Answers come from the players; attendance and absences are recorded by the staff.
summary.scrollHint: Scroll the table sideways to see every column.

banner.many: You have {n} events without an answer in the next 14 days.
event.answerHint: You can change it until the event is over.
event.notYours: This event is not for your groups, so you do not have to answer.
event.recordHint: Once it has started you can record who really came.
event.deleteConfirm: You are about to delete "{title}" of {date}. The answers and the recorded attendance are lost. This cannot be undone.
event.deleteFollowing: Delete this one and the later ones
form.title: Title
form.tooLong: The event lasts more than 12 hours. Check the end time.
form.groupsHint: Choose at least one group. Only these groups see the event.
form.repeatWeeks: Weeks in all, this one included
form.repeatHint: The training repeats on the same day at the same time.

error.names_required: Fill in your first name and last name.

error.email_address_invalid: This email address is not accepted.

error.user_already_exists: There is already an account with this email. Use Sign in.

club.title: Club
club.intro: The club name, logo and colours, visible to every member. Only the board can change them.
club.name: Club name
club.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 1 MB at most. A transparent background works best.
club.logoNone: No badge. A stick and a puck are shown instead.
club.logoTooBig: The image is over 1 MB. Choose a lighter one.
club.logoType: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
club.coloursHint: The club panel and the next game panel use these colours. Each group can have its own in the group settings.
profile.photoHint: Only club members see it. It is cropped to a square and made smaller.
profile.photoUnreadable: This image will not open. Try a JPEG or PNG photo.
settings.title: Settings
settings.groupsHint: Names, codes, colours and pictures of the teams.
settings.invitesHint: Links to let new members in.
groups.intro: Tap a group to change it. Only the board can change groups.
groups.name: Name
groups.codeHint: From 1 to 4 letters or digits, for example C1.
groups.ownColours: Its own colours for game day
groups.deleteConfirm: Delete the group {name}? Its {n} members stay in the club but leave the group. The group's invites will stop working.
groups.codeTaken: Another group already uses this code.
groups.hasEvents: There are events for this group only. Delete them first, or give them another group.
invites.none: No invites yet. Choose a group and create the first one.
dash.allDone: You have answered every coming event.
invites.shareText: Here is your invite to the club app:
stats.title: Statistics
stats.intro: The games played this season: the team's results and every player's numbers.
game.noStats: The statistics have not been filled in yet.
game.nobodyPlayed: Nobody is down as having played yet.
game.nobodyPlayedStaff: Nobody is down as having played. Record the attendance below, then fill in the statistics.
game.voteHint: Give your team mates a mark from 1 to 10 and choose the MVP. You will see the others' marks once you have voted. A vote cannot be changed.
game.waitEnd: You can rate your team mates once the game is over.
game.thanks: Thank you, your vote has been recorded.
error.not_in_game: Numbers can only go in for people who played. Check the attendance.
error.stats_check: Saves cannot be more than the shots against.
error.game_not_over: Voting opens once the game is over.
error.already_voted: You have already voted for this game.
error.mvp_invalid: Pick as MVP a team mate who played.
error.rating_invalid: Marks run from 1 to 10, and only for team mates who played.
absence.title: Away days
absence.intro: If you already know you will be away, put it here. Events of your groups on those days get the answer Not coming, including ones created later. A single event's answer can always be changed.
absence.introStaff: Events of {name}'s groups on those days get the answer Not coming, including ones created later.
absence.reason: Reason, seen by the staff only
absence.toBeforeFrom: The end date has to be the same as the start or later.
absence.tooLong: Away days can last a year at most.
error.period_past: That period is already over. Choose dates from today on.
share.missing: Nudge the ones who have not answered

docs.title: Documents
docs.intro: Everything the club needs from you. Only you, the coaches and the board see it.
docs.introStaff: Only {name}, the coaches and the board see it.
docs.certDateHint: The expiry date printed on the certificate.
docs.certUpload: Upload a photo or a PDF
docs.fileType: Use a photo or a PDF.

docs.consentAccept: I have read it and I accept
docs.consentOnlyMember: Only the member can give or withdraw their own consent.
banner.certExpired: Your medical certificate has run out.
banner.certSoon: Your medical certificate runs out on {date}.
banner.consent: Read and accept the club's privacy notice.
club.noticeHint: The PDF members read and accept on their Documents page. When a new version is uploaded, members who accepted the previous one must accept it again.
club.noticeType: Upload a PDF file of 5 MB at most.
club.jerseysHint: The names of the club's two shirts, as they show on games and in messages.
champ.title: League

groups.leagueEmpty: The league data has not been read yet. Open the League page, then come back here.
settings.rinksHint: The club's rinks and the price per hour.
settings.iceHint: How many hours we use, per rink and per month.
rinks.intro: The rinks the club uses. Every training and every game can have its rink, and that is where the hours are counted. The price per hour is optional and only the board sees it.
rinks.empty: No rinks. Add the first one.
rinks.name: Name
rinks.removeConfirm: Delete the rink "{name}"? The price is deleted with it.
rinks.inUse: Some events use this rink. Change the rink of those events first.
rinks.nameTaken: There is already a rink with this name.
rinks.priceInvalid: Write the price in euros, for example 150 or 150.50.
form.rinkHint: Used to count the ice hours.
event.cancelledBanner: This event has been called off.
event.cancelHint: The event stays in the list, marked as called off, and its hours are counted apart. To take it away completely use Delete.
event.cancelBody: You are about to call off "{title}" of {date}. The players are told. You can put the event back on from the menu.
event.restoreHint: If you put it back on, the players are told again.
error.event_cancelled: The event has been called off, you cannot answer.
ice.title: Ice hours
ice.intro: The booked hours are the start and end of every event that has a rink. An event with nobody there counts all the same. Events called off are counted apart.
ice.noRinkHint: Some events have no rink, so they are not counted against any rink. Open them and choose the rink.
ice.noRinks: Add the rinks first, in Settings, Rinks.
ice.scrollHint: Scroll the table to see every column.
calendar.title: Calendar on your phone
calendar.intro: Add the club's events to your phone calendar. You see the same events as here, with the times and places, and they update by themselves.
calendar.copyFailed: Copying did not work. Press and hold the link and copy it by hand.
calendar.privateHint: The link is yours alone: whoever has it sees your events. Do not share it.
calendar.delayHint: The phone calendar updates by itself, but it can take a few hours. Google Calendar is the slowest.
calendar.renewWarning: The old link stops working and you will have to add the calendar again.
reminders.title: Club emails
reminders.label: Get the club emails
reminders.hint: These are the reminders for events you have not answered (a first one when less than three days are left and a second when less than a day is left) and the announcements that coaches and the board choose to send by email as well. We do not write at night.
invites.team.title: Team link
invites.team.intro: One link for the whole group, valid for the number of days and people set. People already in the group do not take a place. Visible to the board only.
invites.team.once: This link works for several people. It is shown once only, so copy it now and send it to the group. You can revoke it at any time.
invites.team.status: Team link: {used} of {max} places used, valid until {date}
error.team_invite_invalid: Choose from 1 to 90 days and from 2 to 200 people.
pwa.update: A new version of the app is ready.
install.title: App on your phone
install.done: The app is already installed on this device.
install.ios: On an iPhone tap the browser's Share button and choose Add to Home Screen.
install.other: From the browser menu choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
grid.title: Attendance grid
grid.intro: One group and one month: every player for every event. Where the staff recorded attendance it is shown; otherwise the player’s answer.
grid.empty: No events for this group this month.
grid.noMembers: This group has no players yet.

grid.answerOf.present: Said they are coming, attendance not recorded yet
grid.answerOf.absent: Said they are not coming, attendance not recorded yet

ann.intro: Messages from the coaches and the board for your groups.

form.groupsLeague: League games take their groups from the link with the league, so they are not changed here.
form.groupsEnded: The event is over, the groups cannot be changed any more.
form.scopeFollowing: This one and the later ones of the series

error.event_ended: The event is over, it cannot be changed any more.
error.scope_invalid: That choice is not valid. Try again.

lineup.help: Tap a place, then choose who plays it. Tap again to change it or free it.
lineup.overHint: The event is over: the line-up stays as it was.

drills.intro: The club's drills. Write one once and use it in as many trainings as you like.

drills.videoHint: Only addresses that start with https. Long videos work better as links.
drills.fileType: Only images or PDFs can be uploaded.
